title: A recovered Codex stream notice rejects a completed qualification turn
target: sm_103a task preparation; no GPU evaluation reached

evidence.indices: The 19 stdout events include one thread.started, one turn.started, an error at index 10 saying Reconnecting... 2/5 (stream disconnected before completion: IO error: peer closed connection without sending TLS close_notify...), and one turn.completed at index 18. Indices 2, 3 and 17 carry the same terminal JSON; the file write follows the notice. Indices are zero-based.
evidence.upstream: openai/codex rust-v0.153.4, codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_jsonl_output.rs: ServerNotification::Error emits a top-level error and stays Running; TurnStatus::Completed independently emits turn.completed. The exec_events.rs comment calling every top-level error unrecoverable is insufficient to describe the observed recovered stream.

observation: The adapter reaches parsing after a zero process exit, but its admitted top-level event set excludes error. An in-memory diagnostic replay excluding only that event parsed with duplicate_exact_bracketed, and the candidate matched the first-turn qualification plan. Neither that replay nor the output file establishes two-turn qualification. The original failed run remains failed. The remote raw artifacts are currently inaccessible because SSH to the jump host is down.
proposed_change: For tool_rich_candidate_v1 only, recognize the observed bounded Reconnecting... n/5 stream-disconnected notice and retain an indexed auxiliary projection. Continue to reject arbitrary/fatal errors, malformed notices, failed or incomplete turns, incomplete item lifecycles, wrong terminals and invalid candidates. Preserve original raw JSONL and token accounting. Do not launch another provider call as a substitute for deterministic replay.

partial_verification.scope: Synthetic positive and adversarial protocol fixtures, native invocation/qualification regression tests, and comparison input checks. No provider call or GPU execution.
partial_verification.remaining: Replay the exact retained remote provider_stdout plus candidate after SSH recovery, then perform a new two-turn qualification. verified_by remains null; the original failure has not been reclassified.
